ticket.title: Ticket
ticket.description: A Jira key such as PAY-142, or a GitHub issue such as acme/payments#42

ignore_dependencies.title: Start even if earlier slices are open
ignore_dependencies.description: A slice written by the issue splitter says which slices it depends on and is not started while they are open. Set this to start it anyway.

base_branch.title: Base branch
base_branch.description: Branch to build on and open the pull request against; leave empty for the default branch

def.description: Read the ticket from Jira or from GitHub.
Read the Jira ticket through the Jira MCP server.
Read the GitHub issue and its first comments.
Turn the Jira ticket or GitHub issue into one plain ticket (key, title, description, priority, reporter).
Are the slices this ticket depends on still open? (An ordinary ticket is never blocked.)
Stop at once, with the reason, while an earlier slice is open; otherwise go on to the readiness check.
Which earlier slices are still open.

input.map: {'ticket': inputs.ticket, 'deps': nodes.deps.output}

def.description: Tell the channel the ticket has to wait, and for what.
Score the ticket against the seven definition-of-ready gates (definition-of-ready skill).

input.map: {'ticket': nodes.intake.output, 'repository': inputs.repo}

def.description: Three ways out of the readiness check: ready (all seven gates pass, none with low confidence), clarify (a person can answer what is missing), or stop (the ticket needs splitting or is not code, which an answer cannot fix).
def.expression: !nodes.dor_check.output.dispatchable || nodes.dor_check.output.gates.exists(g, g.gate == 'one_pr_scope' && g.status == 'fail') ? 'stop' : nodes.dor_check.output.gates.all(g, g.status == 'pass' && g.confidence != 'low') ? 'ready' : 'clarify'

def.description: Nothing to ask - the ticket is ready. Marks the ready branch for the join below.
Why the ticket cannot be built as written, and what to change.

input.map: {'ticket': nodes.intake.output, 'dor': nodes.dor_check.output, 'failed': nodes.dor_check.output.gates.filter(g, g.status == 'fail' || g.confidence == 'low')}

def.description: Tell the channel the ticket needs to change before anything is built.
The questions the run is waiting on.

input.map: {'ticket': nodes.intake.output, 'dor': nodes.dor_check.output, 'failed': nodes.dor_check.output.gates.filter(g, g.status == 'fail' || g.confidence == 'low')}

def.description: Tell the channel the run is waiting for answers.

A person answers what the readiness check could not settle; the run continues with their answers, or stops if they reject. Answer in mission control, with azhi approve, or from the Slack approval message.

message.cel: nodes.intake.output.key + ' is not ready to build as written: ' + nodes.dor_check.output.summary + ' Answer the ' + string(size(nodes.dor_check.output.gates.filter(g, g.status == 'fail' || g.confidence == 'low'))) + ' question(s) below to continue, or reject to stop.'

payload.map: {'ticket': nodes.intake.output.key, 'questions': nodes.dor_check.output.gates.filter(g, g.status == 'fail' || g.confidence == 'low').map(g, {'gate': g.gate, 'finding': g.finding, 'question': has(g.question) ? g.question : ''})}

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: One answer per question, in order. They are treated as decisions by the requirements and design steps.

def.description: Carry the answers (if any) to the requirements and design steps; skipped when the run stopped or the clarification was rejected.

input.map: {'answers': has(nodes.clarification) ? nodes.clarification.output.data.answers : ''}

def.description: Turn the ticket into testable requirements grounded in the code (requirements-brief and decision-rubric skills).

input.map: {'ticket': nodes.intake.output, 'repository': inputs.repo, 'clarifications': nodes.clarified.output.answers}

def.description: Weigh the approaches, plan the change file by file and report the risk signals (implementation-plan and decision-rubric skills).

input.map: {'ticket': nodes.intake.output, 'requirements': nodes.requirements.output, 'clarifications': nodes.clarified.output.answers}

def.description: Propose the weight of the change from the design's signals: full when the risk is high, a sensitive area or a migration is touched, the change is wide, or confidence is low; otherwise lite.
def.expression: nodes.design.output.risk == 'high' || nodes.design.output.touches_sensitive || nodes.design.output.has_migration || size(nodes.design.output.files) > config.lite_max_files || nodes.design.output.confidence < config.lite_min_confidence ? 'full' : 'lite'

def.description: A senior engineer answers the open questions, confirms the design and the review path (lite or full) before any code is written.

message.cel: 'Approve the design for ' + nodes.intake.output.key + ': ' + nodes.design.output.summary + '? Proposed review path: ' + nodes.weight_proposal.output.route + ' (risk ' + nodes.design.output.risk + ', ' + string(size(nodes.design.output.files)) + ' file(s)). Answer the ' + string(size(nodes.requirements.output.open_questions) + size(nodes.design.output.open_questions)) + ' open question(s) first.'

payload.map: {'open_questions': nodes.requirements.output.open_questions + nodes.design.output.open_questions, 'requirements': nodes.requirements.output, 'design': nodes.design.output, 'proposed_weight': {'path': nodes.weight_proposal.output.route, 'risk': nodes.design.output.risk, 'risk_reasons': nodes.design.output.risk_reasons, 'sensitive': nodes.design.output.touches_sensitive, 'migration': nodes.design.output.has_migration, 'files': size(nodes.design.output.files), 'confidence': nodes.design.output.confidence}}

answers.title: Answers to the open questions
answers.description: One answer per open question, or: use the recommended defaults

weight.title: Review path
weight.description: auto uses the proposed path; lite is one combined reviewer and one fix round; full is three reviewers and two fix rounds

def.description: The review path for this change - the approver's choice, or the proposal when they left it on auto.

input.map: {'proposed': nodes.weight_proposal.output.route, 'final': nodes.weight.output.route, 'overridden_by': nodes.weight.output.route != nodes.weight_proposal.output.route ? nodes.design_review.output.by : ''}

def.description: Implement the approved plan in the checkout; the worker then runs the tests (implement-change and ai-sdlc-governance skills).

def.expression: [nodes.lite_review_1.output].all(v, !v.prompt_injection_detected && (v.approved || v.findings.exists(f, (f.severity == 'critical' || f.severity == 'major'))) && !v.findings.exists(f, (f.severity == 'critical' || f.severity == 'major') && nodes.lite_verify_1.output.checks.exists(c, c.id == f.id && c.verdict == 'confirmed' && c.confidence >= config.min_confidence))) ? 'ok' : 'fix'
